AEO & SEO - Get Found by AI and Search

Web design, Webflow development, and now — making sure the machines can read you. Bots overtook humans as the majority of web traffic in 2024, and AI answers are quietly eating the clicks that used to reach your site. We build beautiful Webflow sites, and we make sure ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Claude and Gemini can find them, understand them, and name you in the answer.

Start Free: Scan Your Site with Bot Appétit

Before you spend a cent, run your site through Bot Appétit — our free AEO and SEO scanner. Paste in a URL and you'll get a 0–100 score in about 20 seconds, broken down across security, classic SEO, structured data, AEO and content, AI access, link health and live Core Web Vitals. No signup, no email, no trial that ambushes you later, and it works on any platform — WordPress, Shopify, Squarespace, hand-rolled HTML from 2011. We built it because we were doing all of this by hand on every project. Bring us your results and we'll tell you which of the red flags actually cost you money and which ones are noise.

AEO Audit — Answer Engine Optimisation Audit

An AEO audit checks whether AI answer engines can crawl your site, understand what it says, and cite you as the source. We go well past the free one-page scan: every page template, every CMS collection, your robots.txt, sitemap, structured data, heading architecture and content structure — scored, then ranked by impact against effort. You get a plain-English report with a prioritised fix list, not a 200-page PDF that dies in a Downloads folder. If you want us to do the fixing too, the audit rolls into the build.

AI Visibility & Citation Testing

We ask the answer engines your buyers' actual questions and record what comes back. Are you named? Cited with a link? Ignored entirely? Is a competitor being quoted on a topic you literally wrote the guide for? We run a defined prompt set across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews and Claude, log the results, and re-run them over time so you can see the line move. This is the only measurement that answers the question clients actually ask — "can AI find us?" — rather than a tool's proxy for it.

AI Crawler Access & robots.txt Configuration

You cannot be cited by a crawler you've locked out. We audit and configure your robots.txt with an explicit, intentional rule per AI bot — GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended and the rest — so you're not accidentally invisible because a plugin blocked everything in 2023 and nobody noticed. We'll also set Content Signals (search, ai-input, ai-train) so you can allow AI to answer with your content while declining to be training data, and check that your CDN or bot protection isn't quietly 403-ing the crawlers your robots.txt says are welcome.

Structured Data & Schema Markup (JSON-LD)

Structured data is the machine-readable version of "this is who we are and what this page is." We implement and validate JSON-LD across your site — Organization with sameAs, Article, FAQPage, BreadcrumbList, Product, LocalBusiness, Person — built as dynamic templates in the Webflow CMS so every new blog post, product or project publishes with correct schema automatically instead of relying on someone remembering. Correct schema is the difference between an AI confidently naming you and vaguely gesturing at "a South African web studio."

llms.txt & Machine-Readable Discovery Files

We add and maintain the well-known files that let AI agents discover and map your site: llms.txt (a curated markdown map of your key content), the Link: rel="describedby" header that advertises it, security.txt, and a sitemap with accurate lastmod dates so crawlers know what actually changed. Straight answer on llms.txt: it's an emerging convention, no major engine has confirmed they use it, and anyone selling it as a ranking factor is selling you something. It's cheap, correct hygiene — we'll set it up properly and tell you honestly where it sits.

Markdown for AI Agents

HTML is mostly scaffolding as far as a language model is concerned — styling, scripts, navigation, layout — and every byte of it burns context that could have gone on your actual content. We set your site up to serve a clean markdown version of any page when an AI agent asks for one, while humans carry on getting the normal page. Same content, different format, no second copy to maintain and nothing to change in your CMS. It cuts what a machine has to chew through by roughly 80%, and we verify it's genuinely working rather than quietly serving HTML anyway.

Indexing & Crawl Acceleration — IndexNow, Bing & Search Console

ChatGPT Search runs on Bing's index, which means the fastest route into an AI answer is the one almost nobody uses: IndexNow. We wire up IndexNow (a near-flip-of-a-switch job if you're on Cloudflare), set up Bing Webmaster Tools alongside Google Search Console, submit and validate your sitemaps, and make sure publishing a page pings the index in minutes instead of waiting days for a crawl. There is no "submit to AI" button — this is the closest thing that exists.

Content Structuring for Answer Engines

Answer engines don't read your page top to bottom; they lift passages. So we restructure content into self-contained, liftable chunks: one idea per section, descriptive headings that nest properly, real semantic landmarks instead of div soup, lists and tables where they earn their place, FAQ blocks backed by matching schema, and machine-readable author and published/updated dates. The unit of optimisation is no longer the page — it's the individual, independently citable fact.

AEO Copywriting & Content Strategy

We write answer-first copy: the definition in the first sentence, the nuance after, in language a machine can quote without mangling. Then we point it at the right targets — because here's what we learned auditing our own site: you get cited where you own something genuinely distinctive, and you're invisible where you duplicate the platform's own documentation. Another generic "how to use Webflow" post is a gift to Webflow's docs. An original tool, a real dataset, an opinionated take that can't be summarised away — that's what gets named in the answer. We'll help you pick the second kind and write it.

Technical SEO Foundations

The classics still carry the meal, and now two kinds of machine grade you on them. We handle titles, meta descriptions, exactly one H1 per page, heading order, self-referencing canonicals, mobile viewport, descriptive alt text, Open Graph and Twitter card tags, XML sitemaps, and clean 200s with no redirect chains. If you run multiple languages — as we do, in English, French, German and Spanish — we'll get your hreflang reciprocal and correct so the right version serves the right region instead of the four of them competing with each other.

Core Web Vitals & Performance Optimisation

Slow pages lose rankings, conversions and patience. We measure your Core Web Vitals from real Chrome user data and a lab run, then fix what's actually broken — usually images, render-blocking scripts and caching. On Webflow we go further than most can, because we run sites through Cloudflare: edge caching rules, an AVIF/WebP image pipeline via Cloudflare Workers, and compression tuned per asset type. See our Cloudflare optimisation guide for how we do it, or the Webflow Cloudflare Proxy Consultation section below.

Migration & Redirect Protection

Replatforming or restructuring is where hard-won rankings and AI citations go to die. We map every old URL to its new home, implement 301 redirects, keep canonicals and hreflang intact, resubmit sitemaps, and monitor Search Console afterwards so a drop gets caught in days rather than discovered in a quarterly report. Applies whether you're coming from WordPress, moving domains, or just reorganising a site you already like.

AI Traffic & Bot Analytics

You can't manage what you can't see, and standard analytics is close to blind on this. We set up reporting that separates the machines from the humans: which AI crawlers are actually hitting your site and how often, which referrals arrive from ChatGPT, Perplexity and AI Overviews, and what those visitors do once they land. Worth knowing — traffic that arrives from an AI answer converts far better than average organic, because the machine already did the comparison shopping and served you up as the answer.

Agent & MCP Readiness

The frontier course, and we'll be upfront: it's early, adoption is thin, and the stakes today are low. But AI agents are starting to do things on websites rather than just read them, and the discovery layer for that is being built right now — the /.well-known/ agent files, MCP server cards, agent skill declarations, API catalogs, OAuth discovery, web-bot-auth signatures and AI-discovery DNS records. We track this stuff weekly because our scanner has to. If you want to be early rather than retrofitting in eighteen months, we'll set it up.

AEO & SEO Monitoring Retainer

AEO changes roughly every fortnight — new crawlers, new directives, new well-known files, new public arguments between Cloudflare and Google about what any of it means. Best practice from six months ago is already quaint. A monitoring retainer keeps you current: a monthly re-scan and score trend, AI citation tracking against your prompt set, Search Console and Bing health checks, schema validation after site changes, crawler-access review, and a short written update on what moved in the standards and whether it affects you. This is the part that compounds — a one-off audit decays; monitoring doesn't.

AEO Workshop for Your Team

A 90-minute session, on Zoom or in person, that walks your marketing, content and dev people through what's actually changed and what to do about it. Plain English, no acronym soup, built around your site with your scan results on screen. Your team leaves knowing why AI answers matter to their pipeline, what they can fix themselves in the CMS, and what needs a developer. Popular with agencies and in-house teams who need everyone reading from the same page before a project starts.

White-Label AEO for Agencies

If you're an agency whose clients are asking about AI search and you'd rather not build the capability from scratch, we'll deliver it behind your brand. You front the relationship, we do the audit, the fixes and the reporting, and you get a report with your logo on it. We're a Webflow Premium Partner and we've been doing white-label Webflow builds for agencies for years — this is the same arrangement, new discipline.

Webflow

What's the deal with Milk Moon Studio?

Milk Moon Studio is a Webflow development studio led by Jakes van Eeden. We specialize in building flawless, responsive websites that perform exceptionally. From transforming your Figma designs into high-performing Webflow sites to advanced analytics setups, we’re here to ensure your website not only looks great but drives results.

Before 2020 we were a side hustle, designing sites in Figma and developing them in Webflow during the dead of night. Everything changed when South Africa went into lockdown - we saw this as a chance to travel to our farm the day before lockdown with our puppy.

We decided to specialise and became Webflow Premium Partners. We feel fortunate to have built a plethora of beautiful sites and have been able to forge strong relationships with our clients.

We have gone from a side-hustle to specialising in development, analytics, and more. We are passionate about pushing the boundaries of web development and creating beautiful, functional Webflow websites that are tailored to our clients' needs.

What kind of payments do you accept?

We can accept traditional bank transfers for invoices, swift payments, or payments via PayPal, Stripe, and credit cards. We'll try and send our quotes and invoices in your local currency as far as possible. Generally, ZAR, USD, GBP & Euros are fine.

How much does a web development package cost?

A bespoke custom website is an investment and as such is more expensive than just buying a Wordpress template, but you end up getting exactly what you want. With our Webflow sites there are very few design constraints and you end up with a site that you can maintain on your own. It's also important to note that pricing varies a lot based on the complexity of the build, what assets you already have and how crazy you want to get with interactions and animation.  If you're even slightly unsure, reach out and we can chat, and put together a package for you with a detailed quote. Your build will also include Google Tag Manager and basic Google Analytics integration.

How long does AEO take to show results?

Faster than classic SEO, and here's why: a lot of AEO is technical eligibility rather than earned authority. Unblocking crawlers, fixing schema and firing IndexNow can put you back in the index within days. Content restructuring shows up over weeks as engines re-crawl. Actually being chosen as the cited source is the slow part — that's authority, and it takes genuinely useful content nobody else has. Structure gets you eligible; being worth citing gets you chosen. A perfectly marked-up page of nothing is still nothing, just easier to parse.

Do you only do AEO for Webflow sites?

No. We build exclusively in Webflow, but AEO and SEO work is platform-agnostic and our scanner deliberately doesn't care what your site runs on — WordPress, Shopify, Squarespace, Framer, custom, whatever's holding it together. Audits, structured data, crawler configuration, content restructuring and monitoring all apply the same way. Where the implementation needs hands in the codebase of something we don't build, we'll do the audit and strategy and work alongside your developers.

Can my website serve a markdown version to AI?

Yes, if your site is proxied through Cloudflare on a paid plan. Cloudflare's Markdown for Agents feature converts your HTML pages to markdown at the edge, in real time, whenever an AI agent requests the page with an Accept: text/markdown header — humans keep getting the normal page. It matters because HTML is mostly scaffolding as far as a language model is concerned: Cloudflare measured one of its own blog posts at 16,180 tokens as HTML versus 3,150 as markdown. Less noise, less token waste, and a cleaner read of what your page actually says. You don't maintain a second copy of anything and there's no code to write. We enable it, scope it to the right paths, verify it's genuinely returning markdown rather than silently passing HTML through, and add a rel="alternate" reference so agents can discover it exists.

How do I know if AI can find my website?

Run a free scan on Bot Appétit, our AEO and SEO scanner. It fetches your page the way a crawler does, checks whether AI bots are blocked in robots.txt, whether your structured data is valid, whether your content is structured in liftable chunks, and whether your discovery files are in place — then gives you a 0–100 score in about 20 seconds. The scan tells you whether you're eligible to be cited. To find out whether you're actually being cited, we run AI visibility testing: asking the answer engines your buyers' real questions and recording who gets named.

Do I still need SEO if AI is answering everything?

Yes, more than ever. The two machines grading you now both learned on a web organised by SEO rules. Titles, headings, canonicals, structured data and site speed are the foundation AEO is built on; there's no AI-only shortcut that skips them. What has changed is the payoff. You'll get fewer clicks per ranking, but the visitors who do arrive from an AI answer convert far better, because the machine has already done the comparison shopping and served you up as the recommendation.

What is AEO, and how is it different from SEO?

AEO, answer engine optimisation, is the practice of making your content easy for AI answer engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Claude and Gemini to read, understand, trust and cite. SEO gets you ranked as a link in a list. AEO gets you named inside the answer. They overlap heavily, and nearly everything that's good AEO is also good SEO, but AEO shifts the unit of optimisation from the whole page to the individual, independently citable fact.

Can you help us with Analytics?

We most definitely can. Our sites include basic Google Tag Manager setup, and Google Analytics 4 and Universal Analytics integration. We can also set up more advanced event and conversion tracking, ad tracking from platforms like Google Ads, Facebook, LinkedIn, Pinterest etc. We'll also integrate free heat maps and recording using Tag Manager and Microsoft Clarity for you, but we're open to installing other tools.

Aside from adding analytics , we can also help you with easy to use in Google Data Studio so you don't need to dig to see how your site is performing. We can also set up ad reporting dashboards or integrate data from tools like Supermetrics etc.

If you require standalone analytics services or would just like to chat about what's possible, reach out, and we can have a look at what you already have and how we can help. We are however primarily a Webflow Studio so, we do focus on implementing analytics on our own projects, but if we have the time, we'll help you out.

How quickly can we have a Webflow site up and running?

It mostly depends on how complex the design is and how that will affect the build. Reach out for a chat and we'll give you an estimate of how quick we can have things up and running. The benefit of working exclusively with Webflow is that while designs can be very complex, development time is quite quick.

Do you offer ongoing support packages?

We can definitely help you going forward; though Webflow is such an easy-to-maintain platform, you most likely won't need us to update content etc., for you. That being said, we do like to partner with our clients, so if there is ever anything you need, we're happy to chat and help you out. We tend to get a lot of requests regarding advanced analytics, reporting dashboards, integrating ads tracking, behavioural analytics etc., and we're more than happy to help with that as well.

Do you do SEO?

Yes — and now AEO too, which is the newer half of the job. Every site we build ships search-ready: correct titles and meta descriptions, one H1 per page, clean heading order, canonicals, Open Graph, XML sitemaps, 301 redirects on migration so nothing 404s, and JSON-LD schema built as dynamic CMS templates so your blog posts and products publish with valid Article, FAQPage, Product and Breadcrumb markup automatically. We'll set up Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools, and optimise Core Web Vitals through Cloudflare.

On top of that we now run a full AEO service line — making sure ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews and Claude can crawl, understand and cite you. Audits, AI crawler access, structured data, llms.txt, IndexNow, content restructuring, citation testing and ongoing monitoring. Start with a free scan on Bot Appétit — our own AEO and SEO scanner — then talk to us about what the red bits mean.

Do you use the Client-First style system?

Client-First is a set of guidelines and strategies developed by Finsweet, and yes, we get this question so often it's on the FAQ. And, yes again, we do develop most of our projects using Client-First. To put it simply, it helps us develop organised and maintainable websites that other Webflow developers can understand very easily. Even clients will know what something is just by looking at a class name, and that, in short is why we use Client-First.

We'll be adding more certifications as Webflow expands on the certification program for Webflow Studios like us, and we have the first one:

Does Webflow have a payment platform?

Webflow currently only integrates with Stripe and Paypal by default, which is admittedly, is a teensy bit limiting considering the amount of payment partners out there, but they are best in class tools and worth checking out if you're unsure. Paypal is available in more regions than Stripe, but Stripe does offer a great service called Stripe Atlas where they register and set up a company for you in the United States if your region isn't covered. They'll pretty much do everything and at the end of the process you'll have a company registered in the US for the cost of $500. If that doesn't work for you Webflow can be paired with Foxy.io to easily create e-commerce sites that work almost anywhere, including South Africa. In South African we can enable you to accept payments in Webflow with the help of Foxy.io and WigWag Payments.

What web development platform do you use?

We exclusively use Webflow to develop our sites and design everything from the POV of a Webflow first studio, and it's great, promise, we guarantee you'll love it. There are virtually no design constraints, it comes with a CMS so adding anything from blog posts to FAQs, managing teams and just making edits to 'static' pages are as easy as clicking, typing, and publishing. We'll teach you how to update content, and when it comes to Webflow there's nothing to maintain, there are no updates, no plugins and nothing breaks when an updated version comes out (cough, cough Wordpress). We're gonna list just some of the features you'll love, and you can check out some of our latest Webflow projects.

  • Webflow delivers clean, semantic HTML5, CSS and Javascript.
  • It has a built-in Content Management System and an Ecommerce platform.
  • It allows us to add sleek interactions and animations to your site.
  • Your site will be powered by Amazon Web Services and Fastly with data centres across the globe, zero maintenance, 99.9% uptime guaranteed, super fast CDN and scaling.
  • It offers great security, no need to worry about being hacked.
  • Built-in SEO tools, no more plugins.
  • Great integration with a slew of partners like Zapier etc. and custom code if required.
  • Exportable code if you want to host a static site somewhere else.
